row.conditions_en: Migrate by original version, interface and removal plan; do not replace every API uniformly.
row.conditions_zh: 按条目中的原版本、接口与删除计划迁移，不能统一替换所有 API。
row.fact_en: The 9.1.1 notes repeat quantization APIs marked deprecated in CANN 8.5.0: aclnnQuantMatmul / V2 / V3 / V4 are replaced by V5; aclnnWeightQuantBatchMatmul by V3.
row.fact_zh: 9.1.1 补丁说明重列 CANN 8.5.0 已标记废弃的量化接口：aclnnQuantMatmul / V2 / V3 / V4 替换为 V5；aclnnWeightQuantBatchMatmul 替换为 V3。
row.title_en: Legacy quantization API deprecation and replacement
row.title_zh: 旧量化接口的废弃与替换

row.conditions_en: This table only; master is not equivalent to v9.1.1.
row.conditions_zh: 仅该配套表范围；不假定 master 等价于 v9.1.1。
row.fact_en: cann-ops-transformer 9.1.1 maps to v9.1.1; the table lists CANN 9.1.x, 9.0.x and 8.5.2.
row.fact_zh: cann-ops-transformer 9.1.1 对应源码标签 v9.1.1；配套表列出 CANN 9.1.x、9.0.x、8.5.2。
row.locator: CANN ops combination-package subpackage compatibility table

row.conditions_en: Project-log evidence only; check Q/K/V types, shapes and package availability against matching-tag documentation.
row.conditions_zh: 仅确认项目记录；具体 Q/K/V 数据类型、形状和发布包须按配套标签文档核对。
row.fact_en: The project log states that fused_infer_attention_score supports A5 MXFP8 full quantization.
row.fact_zh: 项目记录指出 fused_infer_attention_score 在 A5 上支持 MXFP8 全量化。

row.conditions_en: DSV4 Top-K path; sparse candidate access is not structured pruning.
row.conditions_zh: DSV4 Top-K 路径；不将候选访问稀疏归为结构化剪枝。
row.fact_en: Adds lightning_indexer_v2, quant_lightning_indexer_v2 and metadata.
row.fact_zh: 增加 lightning_indexer_v2 与 quant_lightning_indexer_v2 及 metadata。

row.conditions_en: Model/hardware restricted; source compatibility must still be checked.
row.conditions_zh: 模型与硬件限定；源码配套仍须核对。
row.fact_en: Adds A5 sparse_flash_mla, mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla and metadata for DSV4.
row.fact_zh: A5 增加 sparse_flash_mla、mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla 及 metadata，面向 DSV4。

row.conditions_en: Keep regular and experimental directories distinct; verify released tags separately.
row.conditions_zh: 正式目录与 experimental 分开；版本标签可用性待逐项确认。
row.fact_en: Adds dedicated A5 fully quantized Dense Attention; the experimental counterpart supports fully quantized MxFP4.
row.fact_zh: A5 新增 Dense Attention 全量化专用算子；experimental 同名算子支持 MxFP4 全量化。

row.conditions_en: The directory reports CANN 9.2 TensorV2 and an opbase restriction on CANN 9.1.
row.conditions_zh: 目录披露 CANN 9.2 TensorV2；CANN 9.1 有 opbase 限制。
row.fact_en: The directory records passing actual strides into addressing and checking layout bounds to fix contiguous-layout assumptions.
row.fact_zh: 目录记录将真实 stride 传至地址计算并检查布局边界，修复按连续布局寻址的问题。

row.conditions_en: MXFP8 high-precision window path; release-package support unconfirmed.
row.conditions_zh: MXFP8 高精窗口路径；发布包支持未确认。
row.fact_en: Directory changes add vTailOptional, blockTableTailOptional and sequsedKvTailOptional, with BF16 tail storage.
row.fact_zh: 目录变更扩展 vTailOptional、blockTableTailOptional、sequsedKvTailOptional 三项输入，尾块使用 BF16。

row.conditions_en: Maintenance dependency changes, not an algorithmic innovation.
row.conditions_zh: 维护分支的依赖变更，不是算法创新。
row.fact_en: Pins memfabric_hybrid and memcache_hybrid to 1.2.0.
row.fact_zh: memfabric_hybrid 与 memcache_hybrid 均锁定 1.2.0。

row.conditions_en: DP-aligned dummy runs; this is not a KV compression-ratio gain.
row.conditions_zh: DP 对齐 dummy run 场景；不是 KV 压缩比例提升。
row.fact_en: Invalidates per-group KV slot mappings before Attention metadata to fix stale writes in DP-aligned dummy runs.
row.fact_zh: 构造 Attention metadata 前使每组 KV slot mapping 失效，修复 DP 对齐 dummy run 的陈旧写入。

row.conditions_en: The fixes have distinct conditions; do not extend them to all hardware.
row.conditions_zh: 两项修复各有场景；不要推及所有硬件。
row.fact_en: Fixes MTP overlay prefix-cache accuracy on 300I DUO and W8A8 MXFP8 buffers during RL weight reload in ACL Graph.
row.fact_zh: 修复 300I DUO 的 MTP overlay prefix-cache 精度，并稳定 ACL Graph 下 RL 权重重载的 W8A8 MXFP8 缓冲。
row.title_en: Quantized buffers and Prefix Cache accuracy
row.title_zh: 量化缓冲与 Prefix Cache 精度

row.conditions_en: Target-path communication optimization; no universal compression multiplier is reported.
row.conditions_zh: 这是目标路径的通信优化；原文没有给出可通用于所有模型的压缩倍数。
row.fact_en: MiniMax-M3 decode TP communication exchanges index queries and local Top-K candidates instead of full index KV data.
row.fact_zh: MiniMax-M3 解码的 TP 通信改为交换索引查询与局部 Top-K 候选，替代完整索引 KV 数据交换。

row.conditions_en: This is an advance notice; distinguish current and later releases.
row.conditions_zh: 这是预告；按当前候选版与后续版本分别处理。
row.fact_en: Future deprecation of enable_sparse_sfa_c8/enable_sparse_li_c8 in favor of KV/indexer dtype options.
row.fact_zh: 后续废弃 enable_sparse_sfa_c8 / enable_sparse_li_c8，改用 KV 与 indexer dtype 参数。

row.conditions_en: Do not reinterpret BF16 as INT8 KV; declared release scope only.
row.conditions_zh: BF16 描述不能替换成 INT8 KV；仅发布矩阵范围。
row.fact_en: The 950DT path integrates SparseFlashMla BF16 KV sparse Attention with DSpark/DSA-CP.
row.fact_zh: 950DT 路径接入 SparseFlashMla BF16 KV 稀疏 Attention 与 DSpark/DSA-CP。

row.conditions_en: Fusion is execution optimization, not independently compression.
row.conditions_zh: 算子融合属于执行优化，不单独视为压缩。
row.fact_en: Integrates GMM-SiTU for supported MoE paths.
row.fact_zh: 接入 GMM-SiTU，用于受支持的 MoE 计算路径。

row.conditions_en: Declared model and 950DT scope only; this is cache execution/layout support, not a quantization ratio.
row.conditions_zh: 限候选版声明的模型与 950DT 路径；这是缓存执行/布局适配，不单独代表量化压缩率。
row.fact_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash adds layerwise KV Cache reuse for physical layers with multiple main-cache specifications.
row.fact_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 增加逐层 KV Cache 复用，支持同一物理层具有多个主缓存规格。
row.title_zh: 逐层 KV Cache 复用

row.conditions_en: Atlas 800 A3 or 950DT; configure formats per the official matrix.
row.conditions_zh: Atlas 800 A3 或 950DT；各格式按官方模型矩阵配置。
row.fact_en: Adds W8A8/MXFP8; FP8 KV mode uses FP8 E4M3 for MSA/index caches while dense GQA remains BF16 by default.
row.fact_zh: 增加 W8A8 / MXFP8；fp8 KV 配置使 MSA 与索引缓存使用 FP8 E4M3，Dense GQA 默认仍是 BF16。

row.conditions_en: Not immediate removal from earlier releases; consult the complete official list and effective version.
row.conditions_zh: 当前候选版不立即删除这些早期版本能力；完整清单及生效版本以官方原文为准。
row.fact_en: The notes announce future removal of listed DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and selected MiniMax/Qwen models from active maintenance, with model-specific CI/nightly coverage ending once effective.
row.fact_zh: 发布说明预告 DeepSeek-R1/V3.1/V3.2、GLM-4.7/5、Kimi-K2 系列、部分 MiniMax/Qwen 等模型将退出活跃维护集合；生效后不再维护相应 CI 与 nightly 测试。
row.locator: Deprecation and Configuration Changes: Upcoming model deprecations

row.title_zh: 本月核查到的现有能力：msModelSlim算法与格式矩阵
row.title_en: Existing capability checked this month: msModelSlim algorithm and format matrices
row.fact_zh: latest目录列LAOS(W4A4)、AutoRound、KVCache Quant、Float Sparse和敏感层分析等；版本说明页未提供足以把这些条目定为11月新增的逐条日期。 未形成可入本月新增计数的事实。
row.fact_en: The latest index lists LAOS W4A4, AutoRound, KVCache Quant, Float Sparse and sensitivity analysis. The release-notes page does not provide sufficient item-level dates to establish these as November additions. The review does not establish facts eligible for the count of new monthly additions.
row.conditions_zh: 本次检索日期是11/24；不能将检索日期当发布时间。
row.conditions_en: The retrieval date is November 24; it must not be used as the publication date.
row.locator: Algorithm index; release_notes page (undated version list)

row.title_zh: 跨实例KV池进一步接入多种推理栈
row.title_en: Cross-instance KV pools reach more inference stacks
row.fact_zh: TokenSpeed接入Mooncake Store作为L3 KV backend；TRT-LLM KVCMv2与LMDeploy接入content-addressed KV pooling和跨实例prefix reuse。 官方集成记录，没有本条可迁用的统一时延或压缩率。
row.fact_en: TokenSpeed integrates Mooncake Store as an L3 KV backend. TensorRT-LLM KVCMv2 and LMDeploy integrate content-addressed KV pooling and cross-instance prefix reuse. This is an official integration record, without a universal latency or compression-ratio result transferable to this item.
row.conditions_zh: 各推理栈和连接器版本独立检查；不能直接继承其他量化格式。
row.conditions_en: Check each inference-stack and connector version independently; support for other quantization formats does not transfer automatically.

row.title_zh: MXFP4检查点在Hopper上可改以block-FP8执行
row.title_en: MXFP4 checkpoints can execute as block-FP8 on Hopper
row.fact_zh: 发布说明列DeepSeek-V4/V4.1的MXFP4 experts在Hopper通过Humming以block FP8执行。 发布说明汇总在4×H200上decode提升9–21%，对应PR #61875。
row.fact_en: The release notes list Humming execution of DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MXFP4 experts as block FP8 on Hopper. The release notes summarize a 9–21% decode improvement on 4×H200, linked to PR #61875.
row.conditions_zh: 仅发布说明指定模型、Hopper/4×H200；没有在本次进一步核对PR完整负载。
row.conditions_en: The observation concerns the release-note models on Hopper with 4×H200. The full PR workload was not checked further in this review.
row.locator: Highlights / Faster decode on NVIDIA; PR #61875

row.title_zh: 新模型把量化、压缩注意力与草稿训练一起设计
row.title_en: A new model co-designs quantization, compressed attention and draft training
row.fact_zh: 官方首发说明：280B总/14B激活，43层中37 HCA+6 MLA-DSA；默认routed experts为MXFP4(W4A8) QAT，其余权重FP8，KV FP8，indexer cache可MXFP4。 作者称QAT无损、FlashIndexer在1M上下文1.4×；文章未给本次可录入的逐任务QAT质量表或完整系统硬件对照。
row.fact_en: The official launch describes 280B total and 14B active parameters, with 37 HCA and 6 MLA-DSA layers among 43 layers. Default routed experts use MXFP4 W4A8 QAT; other weights are FP8, KV is FP8, and the indexer cache can use MXFP4. The authors describe QAT as lossless and report a 1.4× FlashIndexer speedup at a one-million-token context. The article does not provide the per-task QAT quality table or complete system hardware comparison needed for this review.
row.conditions_zh: 插件绑定官方vllm==0.32.0；1.4×是indexing/prefill索引路径指标，不能改写成模型E2E 40%收益。
row.conditions_en: The plugin binds to the official vllm==0.32.0 wheel. The 1.4× figure concerns indexing/prefill indexing, not a forty-percent end-to-end model gain.
row.locator: Model Architecture Overview; Kernel Fusion; Plug-and-Play Sparse Indexer Routing; FP4 Quantization-Aware Training

row.title_en: NVFP4 W4A16 and W4A4 use different execution paths
row.fact_zh: 新增MegaMoE的NVFP4 W4A16与SiTU；compressed-tensors NVFP4 W4A4 linear可在SM100显式选择FP4 Marlin。 功能/正确性变化为主；同版另有Qwen3-8B-FP8/B200单请求decode TPOT降低1.9%的SwiGLU融合汇总，不能归给NVFP4方案。
row.fact_en: MegaMoE gains NVFP4 W4A16 and SiTU support. Compressed-tensors NVFP4 W4A4 linear layers can explicitly select FP4 Marlin on SM100. These items primarily change functionality and correctness. The same release separately summarizes a 1.9% reduction in single-request decode TPOT from SwiGLU fusion on Qwen3-8B-FP8/B200; that result cannot be attributed to the NVFP4 paths.
row.conditions_zh: W4A4路线要求--fp4-gemm-backend marlin及SM100；对应 #44213；W4A16 #44036。
row.conditions_en: The W4A4 path requires --fp4-gemm-backend marlin and SM100, as described in #44213. The W4A16 item is #44036.

row.title_zh: FP8权重不意味着激活也必须8位
row.title_en: FP8 weights do not require eight-bit activations
row.fact_zh: 新增mm_bf16_fp8/mm_fp16_fp8：BF16或FP16激活乘FP8 E4M3权重[N,K]，单FP32 scale，在核内反量化。 功能支持记录，无本轮核实的端到端速度数。
row.fact_en: New mm_bf16_fp8/mm_fp16_fp8 operators multiply BF16 or FP16 activations by FP8 E4M3 weights in [N,K] layout with one FP32 scale, dequantizing the weights inside the kernel. This records functional support, without an end-to-end speed measurement verified in this review.
row.conditions_zh: H100 sm_90a、B200、B300；CuTe DSL首次编译，需要调用方输出与workspace。
row.conditions_en: H100 sm_90a, B200 and B300; CuTe DSL compiles on first use and requires caller-provided output and workspace buffers.
row.locator: v0.7.5 Highlights / FP8-weight GEMMs with 16-bit activations; #7495

row.title_zh: 低精度执行开始显式约束跨batch数值一致性
row.title_en: Low-precision execution gains explicit numerical invariance across batches
row.fact_zh: mm_bf16/bmm_fp8/mm_mxfp8/mm_fp4与MXFP8/MXFP4/NVFP4 quantizers增加batch_invariant=True；0.7.5扩展到注意力等。 本项为数值一致性契约，不代表质量无损或零性能开销。
row.fact_en: mm_bf16, bmm_fp8, mm_mxfp8, mm_fp4 and MXFP8/MXFP4/NVFP4 quantizers gain batch_invariant=True. v0.7.5 extends the mode to attention and other operations. This is a numerical-consistency contract, not a guarantee of lossless quality or zero performance overhead.
row.conditions_zh: B200/B300/Rubin；要求backend=auto，不支持的输入/设备报错。
row.conditions_en: B200, B300 and Rubin; backend=auto is required, and unsupported inputs or devices raise an error.
row.locator: v0.7.4 Highlights / Batch-invariant GEMMs and quantizers; #8361, #8453, #8536, #8537, #8565

row.title_zh: 自动按文件或bpw预算选择量化类型
row.title_en: Automatically select quantization types for a file-size or bpw budget
row.fact_zh: 发布日志列按file/bpw target size自动选取较低误差quant types的quantize选项。 本次仅核对release body，未审完整算法、基准或结果表。
row.fact_en: The release log lists a quantize option that automatically chooses lower-error quantization types to meet a file-size or bits-per-weight target. Only the release body was checked here; the complete algorithm, benchmarks and result tables were not reviewed.
row.conditions_zh: 对应PR #15550；本次llama.cpp first-page仅20发布，最早11/23，未覆盖全月。
row.conditions_en: PR #15550. The first release page inspected contains twenty releases and reaches only November 23, so it does not cover the full month.

row.title_zh: FP4与2:4稀疏在内核层发生组合
row.title_en: FP4 and 2:4 sparsity combine at the kernel level
row.fact_zh: CuTe DSL/Primitives加入FP4 MMA的2:4结构稀疏及Rubin sparse blockscaled GEMM示例；Blackwell另有MXFP8 block-scale EFC。 发布说明提供原语与示例，不构成模型剪枝可用性或端到端加速证据。
row.fact_en: CuTe DSL/Primitives add 2:4 structured sparsity for FP4 MMA and a Rubin sparse block-scaled GEMM example. Blackwell separately gains MXFP8 block-scale EFC support. The release provides primitives and examples, not evidence of model-pruning usability or end-to-end speedups.
row.conditions_zh: 开发版；按具体Rubin/Blackwell例子与MMA格式核对，不能泛化至其他芯片。
row.conditions_en: This is a development release. Check the specific Rubin/Blackwell examples and MMA formats; do not generalize to other chips.
row.locator: CuTe DSL / New features; Primitives; New example kernels

row.title_zh: 本月核查到的现有能力：CANN源码与标签入口
row.title_en: Existing capability checked this month: CANN source and tag entry points
row.fact_zh: 已抓取发布管理和ops-transformer入口；仅凭入口/现有v9.1.1标签不能认定本月发布新精度能力。 无足够日期证据，不计11月发布。
row.fact_en: Release-management and ops-transformer entry points were fetched. Their availability and the existing v9.1.1 tag do not establish a new precision capability released this month. There is insufficient date evidence, so this item is not counted as a November release.
row.conditions_zh: public index acquisition only；未做全提交历史审计。
row.conditions_en: Only public indexes were acquired; the full commit history was not audited.
row.locator: Registered source index; date evidence missing

row.title_en: Separate the 950DT FP8 indexer cache from A2/A3 INT8 QSFA
row.fact_zh: 950DT的GLM-5.3-Flash CANN KeyPool增加可选FP8 Lightning Indexer key-cache；A2/A3优化INT8 QSFA。 发布说明报告减小cache消耗和减少冗余计算/搬运，未列可复用的数值收益。
row.fact_en: GLM-5.3-Flash CANN KeyPool on 950DT gains an optional FP8 Lightning Indexer key cache. A2/A3 receive INT8 QSFA optimizations. The release notes describe lower cache consumption and less redundant computation or data movement, without reusable numerical gains.
row.conditions_zh: 950DT、GLM-5.3-Flash、CANN KeyPool、可选FP8；A2/A3则为INT8 QSFA。
row.conditions_en: The optional FP8 item is specific to 950DT, GLM-5.3-Flash and CANN KeyPool. The A2/A3 item concerns INT8 QSFA.
row.locator: Highlights / Attention kernels; KV Cache and Transfer; #20447, #20584

row.title_zh: 昇腾动态W4A8：INT4权重与逐token INT8激活
row.title_en: Dynamic W4A8 on Ascend: INT4 weights and per-token INT8 activations
row.fact_zh: 候选版加入ModelSlim W4A8 Dynamic Linear，原文明确INT4 weights和per-token INT8 activation quantization；另修正MXFP打包尾部mask。 本条为官方实现支持，没有给出本轮可抄入对照表的同条件速度或精度数值。
row.fact_en: The release candidate adds ModelSlim W4A8 Dynamic Linear, explicitly using INT4 weights and per-token INT8 activation quantization. It also fixes MXFP packed-store tail masking. This is official implementation support. The item provides no matched speed or quality numbers suitable for this review's comparison table.
row.conditions_zh: 硬件/模型按release的model-support表和相应教程逐一核对；该说明不是310P全栈支持声明。
row.conditions_en: Check each hardware/model combination against the release model-support table and its tutorial. This item is not a statement of full-stack 310P support.

row.title_zh: KV能装更多，可能来自配额回收
row.title_en: A larger KV capacity can come from reclaiming the allocation budget
row.fact_zh: 默认在图捕获和warmup之后按实际空闲显存分配KV池，默认块大小从16改64。 发布说明示例MiniMax-M3/H200可缓存token数433k→672k；另列部分H200高并发模型TPOT上升6–18%。
row.fact_en: The default now allocates the KV pool from memory actually free after graph capture and warmup. The default block size changes from 16 to 64. The release notes give a MiniMax-M3/H200 example with capacity increasing from 433k to 672k tokens. Separately, they report TPOT increases of 6–18% for some H200 models at high concurrency.
row.conditions_zh: 容量例与TPOT范围来自不同发布说明汇总，不拼成单一实验。TPOT范围注明concurrency128。
row.conditions_en: The capacity example and the TPOT range summarize different release-note observations and must not be combined into one experiment. The TPOT range is stated at concurrency 128.
row.locator: Highlights / Extensible KV cache; Before you upgrade

row.title_zh: 低比特后端会被替换：Marlin W4A8 迁到 Humming
row.title_en: Low-bit backends change: Marlin W4A8 moves to Humming
row.fact_zh: v0.34.0移除Marlin W4A8与QuTLASS/fp_quant；前者改用humming及新的输入量化配置。 本项为兼容性变化，未报告统一模型精度或性能收益。
row.fact_en: v0.34.0 removes Marlin W4A8 and QuTLASS/fp_quant. The former moves to Humming with a new input-quantization configuration. This is a compatibility change. No universal model-quality or performance gain is reported for this item.
row.conditions_zh: 按Before you upgrade表中的配置迁移；不能把所有W4A8文件视为可互换。
row.conditions_en: Follow the configuration migration in the Before you upgrade table; W4A8 files are not necessarily interchangeable.
row.locator: Before you upgrade: QuTLASS / fp_quant removed; Marlin W4A8 removed

row.title_zh: 共享KV的关键开始从搬运转向身份一致性
row.title_en: Shared KV depends increasingly on consistent cache identity
row.fact_zh: 增强model revision、LoRA、request tag与TP KV驻留的cache identity；TP group的replicated KV只存一份，保留末尾partial chunk。 功能/正确性进展，未报告统一命中率或节省倍数。
row.fact_en: Cache identity is strengthened across model revisions, LoRA adapters, request tags and tensor-parallel KV residency. Replicated KV is stored once per TP group, and the final partial chunk is retained. These are functionality and correctness advances, without a universal hit-rate improvement or memory-saving factor.
row.conditions_zh: 必须绑定模型版本、adapter、布局和KV group；部分功能属于新multiprocess运行时。
row.conditions_en: Bind model revision, adapter, layout and KV group. Some functionality belongs to the new multiprocess runtime.

row.title_zh: 低精度KV开始按冷热页面组织
row.title_en: Low-precision KV is being organized around hot and cold pages
row.fact_zh: KVCM V2增加TriAttention、NVFP4 cold-page compression、NVFP4 KV与disk cache；多数模型默认启用V2。 本项发布说明列功能，没有统一压缩率/质量/服务性能对照。
row.fact_en: KVCM V2 adds TriAttention, NVFP4 cold-page compression, NVFP4 KV and disk caching. V2 is enabled by default for most models. The release notes list functionality, without a universal compression-ratio, quality or service-performance comparison.

row.title_en: NVFP4 weights run as W4A16 on Hopper and Ada

row.fact_en: Marlin adds NVFP4 weight-only W4A16 execution, allowing the corresponding checkpoints to run on Hopper and Ada Lovelace. The release separately adds MXFP8 W8A8 Linear/MoE support. Official compatibility and execution support are added; no universal speedup is supplied for this item.

row.conditions_en: NVFP4 W4A16 with Marlin on Hopper/Ada and MXFP8 W8A8 are separate configurations and cannot substitute for one another.

row.title_zh: 同容量NVMe池可接近DRAM，但不代表无代价
row.title_en: An equal-capacity NVMe KV pool can approach DRAM, with conditions and costs
row.fact_zh: 官方实测1.8TB NVMe KV pool与同容量DRAM池：Kimi-K3在48/70/96并发、带64GB写缓冲时吞吐相差1%以内。 70 sessions: DRAM 13,380→NVMe 13,492 tok/s/GPU；p50 TTFT 5.19→4.89s，p90 23.40→21.26s。
row.fact_en: Official Kimi-K3 measurements compare a 1.8 TB NVMe KV pool with an equal-capacity DRAM pool. Throughput stays within one percent at 48, 70 and 96 concurrent sessions when a 64 GB write buffer is present. At seventy sessions, throughput changes from 13,380 tok/s/GPU with DRAM to 13,492 with NVMe. TTFT p50 changes from 5.19 to 4.89 seconds and p90 from 23.40 to 21.26 seconds.
row.conditions_zh: 1P1D共16 MI355X，TP8 prefill+TP8 decode，Kimi-K3 DCP8；FP8 KV；DSpark 4 draft、synthetic acceptance length3.36；AgentX回放；NVMe两个Micron7450 PRO每节点，64GB DRAM写缓冲+16GiB读staging。
row.conditions_en: A 1P1D setup has sixteen MI355X GPUs: TP8 prefill and TP8 decode, with Kimi-K3 DCP8. It uses FP8 KV, DSpark with four draft tokens and synthetic acceptance length 3.36, and AgentX replay. Each node has two Micron 7450 PRO NVMe drives; the NVMe path has a 64 GB DRAM write buffer and 16 GiB read staging.

row.fact_zh: 新增 INT4/INT6/INT8 块量化；INT8 路径动态量化激活，INT4/INT6 权重路径不能据此写成 W4A4/W6A6。
row.conditions_zh: 块大小为 32/64/128；INT8 CPU 路径采用动态逐行/逐块激活量化、INT32 点积及逐块反量化累加。具体 ISA 与 storage 路径按后端核对。
row.fact_en: Adds INT4/INT6/INT8 block quantization; only the stated INT8 path dynamically quantizes activations. INT4/INT6 weight support does not establish W4A4/W6A6.
row.conditions_en: Block sizes are 32/64/128. The INT8 CPU path uses dynamic per-row/per-block activation quantization, INT32 dot products and per-block dequantized accumulation. ISA and storage paths vary by backend.

Standard decoding, FP32 recurrent state, L=16, batch 256, four model-specific single-H100/B300 configurations in Table 1, versus tuned vLLM. Batch 1 has no speedup. Separate low-precision read copies and high-precision recurrence are evaluated separately.
row.conditions_zh: 标准解码，循环状态FP32、L=16、batch=256，采用Table 1四种各自对应的单H100／B300模型配置，对照调优vLLM；batch=1无加速。低精读取副本与高精递推的实验另列。
row.fact_en: Non-flush steps append recent SSM inputs and compute outputs from a checkpoint plus the buffer; only a flush folds inputs into the checkpoint. This reduces repeated state writes. The four FP32-state runs report 1.20–1.47× decode-step speedup; the separate-precision design prevents read-copy rounding error from feeding back into recurrence.
row.fact_zh: 非flush步骤仅追加近期SSM输入，以检查点与缓冲计算输出；flush时才折叠输入并写回检查点，减少反复状态写入。四组FP32状态实验的decode step加速为1.20–1.47倍；另行评估的分精度设计避免读取副本舍入误差回灌递推。

row.conditions_en: Host WER aggregates 14,019 utterances over four corpora and four chunk sizes. Phone timing uses the single-thread Pixel 11 configuration in the parent record. Eligible QC8W linear operations use dynamic A8 and per-channel W8 with FP32 output; some GEMMs remain FP32.
row.conditions_zh: host端在四语料、四种音频块大小下汇总14,019条音频的WER；手机计时采用所属记录的Pixel 11单线程配置。适用QC8W线性运算为动态A8、逐通道W8、FP32输出，部分GEMM仍为FP32。
row.fact_en: ExecuTorch delegates supported operations through XNNPACK to KleidiAI. QC8W adds 0.21–0.31 WER percentage points versus FP32. With the same QC8W artifact, SME2 changes processing time from 5.20 to 3.24 s (1.61×); SME2-enabled FP16 is 4.61 s. Native samples confirm INT8 SME2 alongside FP32 paths.
row.fact_zh: ExecuTorch经XNNPACK将支持算子委派给KleidiAI。QC8W较FP32增加0.21–0.31个WER百分点；相同QC8W产物启用SME2后处理耗时5.20→3.24秒（1.61倍），已启SME2的FP16为4.61秒。原生采样确认INT8 SME2与FP32路径并存。
